BDI.note: Only a planned HR statistical yearbook is mentioned; no records-based statistics published or agreement stated.
Nothing on accessibility for persons with disabilities.
No link between education systems is stated.

facts.fact: UNESCO's notice says the ministry, under a December 2022 Burundi-UNESCO agreement, has built the 'GRH MENRS' human-resources module of its SIGE and installed hardware and software, with internet, solar backup, data import and a first HR statistical yearbook still to come.

BDI.note: No figure on school internet or compulsory digital curriculum; internet is planned for ministry and provincial offices only.
The module is teacher HR management, not learner records.
